experience.title: Open Source Contributor
description: Contributing to Linux distribution build automation, packaging pipeline workflows, and release infrastructure.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer
description: Operate and maintain production microservices infrastructure serving 150K+ active users across healthcare providers.

Migrated a full production stack from on-premise, pipeline-less Docker to Kubernetes during a ground-up rewrite, architecting a 4-node cluster (staging + production) running 10+ services including frontend, backend/admin panel, payment service, database, and Redis.
Designed CI/CD pipelines from scratch (Gitea + Woodpecker CI), enabling several zero-downtime production deployments per day with no service interruption.
Implemented centralized monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and Alertmanager, cutting incident detection to near-instant and worst-case fix-to-redeploy turnaround to under 30 minutes.
Automated server provisioning using Ansible and modular Bash scripting, managing RBAC policies, Ingress, and secrets across the cluster.

experience.title: Backend & DevOps Engineer
description: Engineered and deployed backend services using FastAPI, Django, Docker, and PostgreSQL with Redis caching layers, building automated CI/CD pipelines that eliminated manual deployment steps for client projects.
Administered and hardened Linux production servers, writing modular Bash scripts for routine maintenance and security.
